data.exact_reserve_text: Included within net calendar year claims incurred of $60,654,000 there is a deterioration of $5,306,000 in claims reserves established at the prior year end (2020: release $1,052,000).

prior_year_events.impact_description: Adverse development in the 2019 underwriting year leading to an increase in gross claims outstanding (deterioration/strengthening of reserves)

data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2021 the syndicate reported a gross prior-year deterioration driven primarily by adverse development on the 2019 underwriting year. Using the gross claims development table the 2019 underwriting year shows an increase in the estimated cumulative gross claims of $13.504m (strengthening). The managing agent highlights reserving uncertainty, additional IBNR provision and changes incorporated from pricing and reserving analysis (including margin added above actuarial best estimates) as contributing factors.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (13.504) was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (gross cumulative incurred claims by UW year). The report also states a net prior-year deterioration of $5.306m (net of reinsurance); the figure returned is GROSS (per triangle) as required. All amounts extracted are presented in the report's native currency (USD) and converted from thousands to millions. The statutory segmental analysis by regulatory class is not provided; the note states 'All business written by the syndicate is reinsurance' so a single 'Reinsurance' line was used for premium mix.
